Audio/DVD reproductions can be done by downloading the MP3 file to your computer. If you have any questions, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at 213-978-1046 or send an email to: Clerk.Vault@lacity.org.

COUNCILPHONE
A dial-up system which allows the public to listen to live coverage of the Los Angeles City Public Meetings from any phone. The numbers to the right may be used from any location, not just in Los Angeles. Dial up and listen in.
